Scan this Python file for export-controlled crypto and classify any findings. I need to understand whether our TLS server configuration creates EAR obligations.

```python
# infra/tls/server_config.py
import ssl

ALLOWED_CIPHERS = 'ECDHE+AESGCM:ECDHE+CHACHA20:DHE+AESGCM'
MIN_TLS_VERSION = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2

class TLSServerConfig:
    def __init__(self, certfile: str, keyfile: str):
        self.certfile = certfile
        self.keyfile = keyfile
        self.MIN_TLS_VERSION = MIN_TLS_VERSION
        self.ALLOWED_CIPHERS = ALLOWED_CIPHERS

    def build_context(self, sock):
        context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        context.minimum_version = self.MIN_TLS_VERSION
        context.set_ciphers(self.ALLOWED_CIPHERS)
        context.load_cert_chain(certfile=self.certfile, keyfile=self.keyfile)
        context.options |= ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2 | ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
        return context.wrap_socket(sock, server_side=True)
```
